Usage:  circleci project slack set (--channel <name|ID> | --enable | --disable) [flags]

Flags:
      --channel string   Slack channel name (e.g. #ci-alerts) or ID to send notifications to
      --disable          pause Slack notifications, keeping the configured channel
      --enable           resume Slack notifications for the configured channel
  -h, --help             help for set
      --jq string        Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json             Output as JSON
      --project string   project slug (e.g. gh/org/repo); defaults to git remote
